title: Ordered root-chart tensor and shift calculus
statement: For the derived tensor of [def-weil-derived-tensor] and shifts of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define the ordered tensor-power comparison recursively: the zero stage is the specified unit chart; a successor tensors the preceding comparison with the fixed line chart and then applies the specified unit-step comparison. The unit-step is the canonical K-flat tensor-shift isomorphism followed by the shifted unitor. Exact monoidal functors carry the derived unit to the derived unit using their ordinary unit and exact-derived single-object comparisons. All comparison maps are those composites, with no freely chosen coherence maps.
